newsitem.title: UK: M&G delighted by KEPIT board choice.
newsitem.headline: M&G delighted by KEPIT board choice.

text.p: UK fund management group M&G Plc said it was "delighted" to have been chosen by the independent board of the Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust to manage one of its successor unit trusts.
"M&G believes that tha prospects for long term equity investment in Europe are attractive and that soundly managed unit trusts represent an excellent means to share in the opportunities," M&G said.
Confidence in unit trusts has been badly shaken by last week's suspension of three trusts managed by Morgan Grenfell Asset Management due to "suspected irregularities".
